messages.subject: monte carlo simulation with resampling out of a sem
parts:
dear all,

is it possible with lavaan (possibly with the simulate data function) to create e.g. 1000 covariance matrices with a thousand fictive cases each? i don't need bootstrapping out of real data, but a simulation with resampling. 

thx a lot!

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: monte carlo simulation with resampling out of a sem
parts:
On 05/27/2015 01:27 PM, et wrote:
> dear all,
>
> is it possible with lavaan (possibly with the simulate data function) to
> create e.g. 1000 covariance matrices with a thousand fictive cases each?

Sure. The simulateData() function has an argument 'return.type', which
can be set to 'cov' to return a covariance matrix. And you can set
sample.nobs to 1000.

And you you can wrap this in a loop and run it a 1000 times...

Yves.
